description: This source file defines the UserService class which provides various user management operations such as upserting users, finding users by username or email, listing all users, and toggling user active status within a Java-based Spring application.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: A Spring @Service component providing user management operations, handling user creation, retrieval, listing, and activation status toggling.

methods.name: upsertUser
methods.description: Creates or updates a user based on username, email, and display name. Generates a UUID if the user is new and ensures a single record per username or email.

methods.name: findByUsernameOrEmail
methods.description: Retrieves a user matching the provided username or email using an OR logic.

methods.name: listAll
methods.description: Returns a list of all user records.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Enables or disables a user account identified by userId.
